title: Add implement and review-guide agent profiles
description: Two primary agents in config: implement (changes code, runs checks) and review-guide (reads result, walks user through changes, no auto-continue). Plus report card format: what changed, why, how verified, what remains; details expandable to diff/checks/issues.
acceptance_criteria: profiles committed; report card template documented; pilot task produces a card
close_reason: Profiles added (config/agents/implement.md, review-guide.md) + report card format (docs/report-card.md); both resolve via opencode debug agent and run against the mock provider.

title: Set up e2e container for the harness
description: Run opencode inside a container without touching host config: install pinned opencode, apply config/ via scripts/bootstrap.sh, host network for local LLM endpoints (localhost:1000x), disable rtmate/gitlab custom tools, e2e through 'opencode run' (TUI optional via tmux).
acceptance_criteria: opencode run 'hi' works in container against local model; host ~/.config/opencode untouched; runbook in README
close_reason: Container e2e works: docker/e2e.sh passes (opencode 1.18.32 + mock model, host untouched); runbook added to README

title: Spike Plannotator review loop on opencode 1.18.32
description: Check Plannotator compatibility with opencode 1.18.32: install method, annotation of plans/diffs, how comments return to the agent (MCP/plugin/files), multi-target feedback.
acceptance_criteria: micro-diff reviewed with several comments the agent processes; findings documented
close_reason: Spike done: plugin loads on 1.18.32 (all 4 hooks exist), submit_plan registered (verified via /experimental/tool/ids), container e2e passes with plugin enabled; docs/plannotator.md added. Browser click-through remains as follow-up.

title: Verify Plannotator UI flow interactively
description: Open plan review in the browser, annotate, approve/deny and check the revision loop; run /plannotator-review on a micro-diff with several line comments and confirm the agent processes each item. Requires the plannotator CLI (install.sh --minimal) and a browser.
acceptance_criteria: plan revision loop and micro-diff review both verified by a human
notes: Prep done (2026-09-26): live config applied via scripts/bootstrap.sh (backup: ~/.config/opencode.backup-20260926-185422), plannotator CLI 0.27.20 installed in ~/.local/bin, plugin @plannotator/opencode@0.27.20 pinned in config. Test: restart opencode, then plan review via plan agent (submit_plan), /plannotator-review on a small diff, /plannotator-last. Local data: ~/.plannotator/feedback.

acceptance_criteria: hook blocks a test secret; CI job runs on push
